label: Coastal population
descriptor: Population of Sri Lanka, millions (base-level trend only).

label: Per-capita fish demand
descriptor: Fish consumption per person, kg/yr; doubled in three decades and peaked at 31 kg in 2016.

label: Fleet capacity (boats x power)
descriptor: Fishing capacity of the fleet, in the same units as effort (thousand kW-days/yr).

label: Indian trawler incursions
descriptor: Transboundary incursions by Indian bottom trawlers (qualitative in the article).

label: Illegal bottom trawling
descriptor: Fishing pressure from illegal (mostly Indian) bottom trawling.

label: Fish stock (biomass)
descriptor: Fish biomass, kt; Gordon-Schaefer equilibrium with the article's MSY benchmarks.

label: Fleet motorization (% motorized)
descriptor: Share of motorized boats in the fleet, %; 40% before the tsunami, 60% now.

label: Catch decline
descriptor: Loss of catch (in 2021 the catch equals pre-tsunami levels with twice the effort).

label: Conflict with Indian fishermen
descriptor: Conflicts with Indian fishers (arrests, lost fishing grounds).

label: Traditional fishing decline
descriptor: Decline of the non-motorized traditional fleet.

label: Loss of traditional fishing culture
descriptor: Erosion of traditional practices and local ecological knowledge.

label: Post-tsunami aid (2005-2009)
descriptor: Boats and gear given to rebuild livelihoods after the 2004 tsunami (article: +23% boats by 2008).

label: Post-war aid (2010-2012)
descriptor: Second wave of boats and gear after the end of the civil war in 2009.

label: Effort-based quota
descriptor: Effort-based quota: 5% (MSY) to 25% (MEY) cut, via buybacks or fishing-free days (Table 4).

label: Combating poaching
descriptor: Joint patrols, surveillance and penalties against illegal trawling.
